name: TradeCore ERP
description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-29 CONSOLE SPAM FIX + INFINITE SYNC LOOP FIX: (1) Removed 12 repetitive console.log statements causing 'User session preserved/restored' spam dozens of times per second — the worst offender was line 3966 in a useEffect[currentUser] that fired on every sync cycle. (2) Fixed infinite flush loop by unconditionally clearing ALL flushed dirty keys after successful flush — the previous per-key optimisticWriteTs check kept keys dirty when re-fetch overlays triggered re-saves during the flush window. (3) Removed ≤2 key limit from echo-merge guards so server state is applied directly when the flushed version is confirmed, regardless of pending key count.
